reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer (packet-only: competency text + rendered samples, no generator source), 2026-07-27 re-review batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
What number comes next when counting: 44, 45, 46, 47, ___?
A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Seeds 44 and 45 abandon fractions entirely: 'Find the missing number: 62, 63, 64, 65, ___' (key 66) and 'What number comes next when counting: 44, 45, 46, 47, ___?' (key 48) are whole-number sequencing, not counting halves or quarters. Worse, on seed 42 the distractor '2/4' is numerically equal to the key '1/2', so that MCQ has two mathematically correct choices.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The noun 'quarters' is never realized. Seeds 42, 43 and 46 all emit the byte-identical stem 'A shape is divided into 2 equal parts. 1 part is shaded', so fourths are absent, and so is any actual counting of multiple unit fractions (two halves, three quarters, four quarters making a whole).

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The seed 42 option list offers '2/1' and '2/3'. An improper fraction and a fraction in thirds are notations a Grade 1 Quarter 4 learner has not met under a halves-and-quarters lc, so the distractors require concepts the stem never taught.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Three of the five seeds return one and the same sentence with only the A-D option ordering shuffled; there is no set-partition context (half of 4 cookies), no 'which shape shows one fourth', and no word-form ('one half') variant anywhere in the sample.

competency_alignment.rationale: There is no difficulty ladder toward halves and quarters at all: the three fraction items are the identical single-half case, and the only 'progression' present is the drift into counting on by ones from 62 and from 44, which belongs to a Quarter 1 number-sense lc.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Counting values 44 through 66 are inside a Grade 1 range, but the fraction denominators drift to 3 ('2/3') when this lc caps denominators at 2 and 4, and the numerator 2 over denominator 1 exceeds a whole.
